about_short_description.short_description: Arabius is an online learning platform that offers Arabic certificate courses to students.

product.name: Group Sessions
product.description: Scheduled group Arabic language classes with 3-6 learners at the same level, available online or in-person.

product.name: 1-on-1 Sessions
product.description: Individual Arabic language classes with a dedicated native Saudi guide, offered online or in-person.

product.name: Flex Sessions
product.description: Flexible Arabic language classes allowing learners to choose days, times, and learning modes based on availability.

product.name: Foundational Plan
product.description: Arabic language course focusing on basic vocabulary, pronunciation, and simple conversational skills at Level 1.

product.name: Conversational Plan
product.description: Arabic language course aimed at developing conversational skills, including sentence formation and story narration at Levels 2-3.

product.name: Fluent Plan
product.description: Advanced Arabic language course for achieving fluency, reading skills, and engaging in complex discussions at Levels 4-5.
